messages:
maria: FYI — enterprise customer wants a bulk onboarding flow: upload CSV to assign roles scoped to routes + a preview for effective permissions. Asking for an audit-friendly path and programmatic API too.
avery: +1. They want to onboard 2k service accounts at once and set per-route quotas.
devon: Is this just a console UX or do we need API endpoints for batch operations?
maria: Both. Console should call a protected bulk API so SREs can throttle and we can track telemetry.
li: We should surface the 'effective permissions' diff before commit. Customers repeatedly mis-scope roles. A preview + validation step prevents mistakes.
samir: For the API: propose POST /v1/tenants/{id}/bulk_grants with body:
```
{
  "items": [
    {"principal": "svc-abc", "role": "reader", "scope": {"routes": ["/v1/generate", "/v1/embed"]}},
    {"principal": "svc-def", "role": "caller", "scope": {"routes": ["/v1/chat"]}}
  ],
  "dry_run": true
}
```
maria: love the dry_run flag. also need per-request rate limit and a quota on op size (e.g., 1000 rows) so we don't impact runtime.
avery: For large imports we could return an async job id and let console poll. Job payload size limit + chunking.
devon: Agreed. Also: telemetry — each grant should emit audit log events with before/after and author. Retention policy varies by plan.
li: UX note: show a compact table with collapsed differences, and a 'rollout canary' toggle to apply to 10% of principals first. Enterprise asked for canary.
samir: Canary complicates backend — we'd need to attach a rollout tag to grants and a way to progressively expand. But doable: store grant groups with status {canary, active}.
maria: Can we rely on existing rollout infra used for model routing? Should we reuse policies + A/B expansion?
devon: Reuse makes sense. We already have feature flag style expansion. But tie-ins: permission evaluation must respect grant group status. Might need a cache invalidation path.
li: Important: effective permissions preview must simulate cascading entitlement (role inheritance, service account delegation). Edge cases: scoped tokens, temporary sudo sessions.
avery: Operationally, add an endpoint for dry-run diffs and include risk score: e.g., exposes_changes_to_admin_routes = true/false. Helps support triage.
samir: Implementation note: bulk API should persist a "plan" object with UUID so operators can audit and rollback.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary branch for backend bulk-grants endpoint deployed to staging at 1912345800.
maria: Next steps: devon & samir to prototype API + job queue. li & avery to sketch console flows and preview UX. I'll file a short RFC and link to this thread.
devon: I'll add a schema for the plan object and a sequence diagram for cache invalidation.
li: I'll mock up the compact diff UI and a small test harness for simulated canary expansion.
avery: Flagging quota team — we need per-tenant concurrent bulk jobs limit and per-org total grant changes per day.
maria: Great. Please add blockers to the RFC. We should include telemetry requirements: audit events, plan lifecycle, who-acked the canary.
samir: Also consider a CLI: redwoodctl grants apply --plan <uuid> for infra automation.
maria: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link once it's up.
